sentence: This project tests whether immune activation makes cells copy their immune response genes more than once, and how Down syndrome disrupts this.
This project provides statistical support for cancer researchers, from designing studies to analyzing their data.
This project builds computer methods that use deep neural networks and health records to find atrial fibrillation in patients after a stroke.
This project tries to find out how a fault in a signaling protein disrupts brain development in autism and intellectual disability.
This project supports research on gastrointestinal cancers.
This project studies the genes behind Alzheimer disease in African Americans to understand how the disease develops.
This project studies why some people with atopic dermatitis do not respond to an antibody treatment or get inflammatory skin side effects.
This project builds computer tools that pull clinical details about Alzheimer's disease patients out of electronic health records.
This project studies how the immune system responds to tumors and cancer immunotherapy.
This project builds maps of cellular senescence in mouse tissues using molecular and imaging data.
This project provides biostatistics and bioinformatics support for studies of gastrointestinal cancer.
This project uses stem cells from patients with fatty liver disease to understand how many genetic risk factors combine to cause it.
This project develops a library of tracers that make lung cancer cells visible during procedures.
This project tests a smartphone program that sends real-time messages to reduce alcohol misuse in young women.
This project studies neurological diseases caused by autoantibodies, builds animal models of them, and develops targeted treatments.
This project tries to find out how a protein that binds mRNA drives differentiation and metastasis in colorectal cancer.
This project studies how genes are regulated in cardiovascular disease and in vascular smooth muscle cells during aging.
This project builds an augmented reality tool that uses a camera to measure joint mobility, posture and balance during telehealth rehabilitation.
This project designs ways to fix epigenetic instability in human pluripotent stem cells so they can model early human development.
This project tests whether a positron emission tomography probe can detect how active pulmonary fibrosis is in mice.
